answer:
Your Guest wifi note now has an app on its App side. It shows a large QR code that guests can scan with their phone camera to join the network. Below the code it shows the network name, password and security type.

It reads those details from the note's text, so if you change the password in the note, the code updates by itself. I haven't scanned the code with a phone. The app passed the automatic layout and display checks.

The QR code always has a white background, even in dark mode, because phone cameras scan it more reliably that way.

  "guide": "# Building apps in Amber Notes notes

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner. In the tools it's called the note's page (set_note_page, get_note_page); when you talk to the person, call it "the note's app" or "the App side", and never "page" or "Pages".
